function kS(a, s) {

function Ps(a) {
    if (a instanceof Date) {
        if (isNaN(a.getTime()))
            return "";
        const f = String(a.getDate()).padStart(2, "0")
          , m = String(a.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0")
          , x = a.getFullYear();
        return `${f}/${m}/${x}`
    }
    if (typeof a == "string") {
        const f = a.trim();
        if (!f)
            return "";
        if (/^\d{2}\/\d{2}\/\d{4}$/.test(f))
            return f;
        if (/^\d{2}-\d{2}-\d{4}$/.test(f)) {
            const [x,y,h] = f.split("-");
            return `${x}/${y}/${h}`
        }
        if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(f)) {
            const [x,y,h] = f.split("-");
            return `${h}/${y}/${x}`
        }
        if (/^\d{4}\/\d{2}\/\d{2}$/.test(f)) {
            const [x,y,h] = f.split("/");
            return `${h}/${y}/${x}`
        }
        if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}T/.test(f)) {
            const x = new Date(f);
            if (!isNaN(x.getTime())) {
                const y = String(x.getUTCDate()).padStart(2, "0")
                  , h = String(x.getUTCMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0")
                  , N = x.getUTCFullYear();
                return `${y}/${h}/${N}`
            }
        }
        const m = new Date(f);
        if (!isNaN(m.getTime())) {
            const x = String(m.getUTCDate()).padStart(2, "0")
              , y = String(m.getUTCMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0")
              , h = m.getUTCFullYear();
            return `${x}/${y}/${h}`
        }
        return ""
    }
    if (typeof a != "number")
        return "";
    const s = new Date((a - 25569) * 86400 * 1e3)
      , i = String(s.getUTCDate()).padStart(2, "0")
      , c = String(s.getUTCMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0")
      , d = s.getUTCFullYear();
    return `${i}/${c}/${d}`
}

                                    if (We && /billrefno|bill\s*ref\s*no/i.test(String(We.v))) {
                                        Ce = he;
                                        break e
                                    }
                                }

                                range: Ce,
                                defval: "",
                                raw: !0
                            });
                            if (re.length === 0) {
                                b({
                                    status: "error",
                                    message: `No data rows found after header row ${Ce + 1}.`
                                });
                                return

                              , Re = (...he) => Le.find(it => he.some(We => We.test(it)))

                              , $e = Re(/billvalue/i, /bill\s*value/i)

                              , Oe = Re(/party\s*name/i)
                              , ct = Re(/party\s*code/i)
                              , ft = Re(/salesperson/i);
                            if (!pe || !$e) {
                                b({
                                    status: "error",
                                    message: `Required columns not found (BillRefNo, BillValue). Found: ${Le.slice(0, 12).join(", ")}`
                                });
                                return
                            }
                            const gt = new Map;
                            for (const he of re) {
                                const it = String(he[pe] || "").trim();
                                if (!it)
                                    continue;
                                const We = Number(he[$e]) || 0
                                  , Dt = nt ? Ps(he[nt]) : ""
                                  , Bn = Oe ? String(he[Oe] || "").trim() : ""
                                  , tn = ct ? String(he[ct] || "").trim() : ""
                                  , rn = ft ? Hr(String(he[ft] || "")) : "";
                                gt.has(it) || gt.set(it, {
                                    billAmt: 0,
                                    lineCutAmt: 0,
                                    billDate: "",
                                    partyName: "",
                                    partyCode: "",
                                    salespersonName: ""
                                });
                                const $t = gt.get(it);
                                We > 0 ? $t.billAmt += We : We < 0 && ($t.lineCutAmt += Math.abs(We)),
                                Dt && ($t.billDate = Dt),
                                Bn && ($t.partyName = Bn),
                                tn && ($t.partyCode = tn),
                                rn && ($t.salespersonName = rn)
                            }
                            if (gt.size === 0) {
                                b({
                                    status: "error",
                                    message: "No valid BillRefNo entries found in file."
                                });
                                return
                            }
                            const Wt = Vn()
                              , Yt = new Map(Wt.map(he => [he.billNo, he]));
                            let bt = 0
                              , Ge = 0
                              , ut = 0
                              , mt = 0
                              , Nt = 0
                              , Qt = 0;
                            const en = []
                              , kt = [];
                            for (const [he,it] of gt) {
                                const {billAmt: We, lineCutAmt: Dt, billDate: Bn, partyName: tn, partyCode: rn, salespersonName: $t} = it
                                  , kn = We > 0 && Math.abs(We - Dt) <= 1
                                  , nn = Yt.get(he);
                                if (nn) {
                                    if (vo(nn)) {
                                        Qt++;
                                        continue
                                    }
                                    const ln = nn.collectedAmount || 0
                                      , Sn = We - Dt - ln
                                      , An = ln > 0 && Math.abs(Sn) <= 1
                                      , Bt = {
                                        ...nn,
                                        ...Bn ? {
                                            date: Bn
                                        } : {},
                                        ...tn ? {
                                            partyName: tn
                                        } : {},
                                        ...rn ? {
                                            partyCode: rn
                                        } : {},
                                        ...$t ? {
                                            salespersonName: $t
                                        } : {},
                                        ...We > 0 ? {
                                            billNetAmt: We
                                        } : {},
                                        cancelLine: Dt > 0 ? String(Dt) : nn.cancelLine || "",
                                        outstandingAmount: We - Dt - ln
                                    };
                                    kn ? (Bt.paymentMode = "FBR",
                                    ut++) : An ? Nt++ : !ln && nn.deliveryDate && (Bt.paymentMode = "Credit",
                                    mt++),
                                    en.push(Bt),
                                    bt++
                                } else {
                                    const ln = new Date;
                                    let Sn = ln.getTime();
                                    if (Bn) {
                                        const [Ol,Ll,zn] = Bn.split("/").map(Number);
                                        Ol && Ll && zn && (Sn = new Date(zn,Ll - 1,Ol).getTime())
                                    }
                                    const An = Math.max(0, Math.floor((ln.getTime() - Sn) / 864e5))
                                      , Bt = `${String(ln.getDate()).padStart(2, "0")}/${String(ln.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0")}/${ln.getFullYear()}`;
                                    kt.push({
                                        id: crypto.randomUUID(),
                                        srNo: "",
                                        date: Bn || Bt,
                                        salespersonName: $t,
                                        collectionCode: "",
                                        billNo: he,
                                        partyCode: rn,
                                        partyHulCode: "",
                                        partyName: tn,
                                        beatName: "",
                                        billNetAmt: We,
                                        collectedAmount: 0,
                                        outstandingAmount: We - Dt,
                                        billAgeing: An,
                                        cancelLine: Dt > 0 ? String(Dt) : "",
                                        ...kn ? {
                                            paymentMode: "FBR"
                                        } : {}
                                    }),
                                    kn && ut++,
                                    Ge++
                                }
                            }
                            en.length > 0 && bd(en),
                            kt.length > 0 && Qj(kt);
                            const pt = [];
                            ut && pt.push(`FBR (bill amt ≈ line cut): ${ut} bills`),
                            Nt && pt.push(`Already paid — data updated, status unchanged: ${Nt} bills`),
                            mt && pt.push(`Marked Credit (del date present, not collected): ${mt} bills`),
                            Ge && pt.push(`New bills added: ${Ge}`),
                            Qt && pt.push(`Protected (had payment data, not touched): ${Qt} bills`);
                            const Lt = bt + Ge;
                            b(Lt === 0 && Qt === 0 ? {
                                status: "error",
                                message: "No bills processed. Check file format.",
                                details: pt
                            } : {
                                status: "success",
                                message: `${bt} updated · ${Ge} new · ${ut} FBR · ${Qt} protected`,
                                details: pt
                            })
                        } catch (me) {
                            b({
                                status: "error",
                                message: `Parse error: ${me?.message || "Unknown error"}`
                            })
                        }
                    }
                    , 0)
                }
                ,
                qe.readAsArrayBuffer(Se)
            } catch (xe) {
                b({
                    status: "error",
                    message: `Could not open file: ${xe?.message || "Unknown error"}`
                })
            }
        }
